rev.t: Extremely good service and Nanda is a friendly guy. Opens till 9 pm and has good space for parking on the road. Decently priced. Works on mail prints too.
Went here to get few copies of 4x6 pictures from my pen drive. They charged 8 rupees for each copy and gave the next day. It is usually costlier than online printouts but quicker. …
Good service and excellent experience from this shop. Very cheapest service and good quality service they are provided. Very friendly guy NANDA  will provide  printing through e mail processing too.
